page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel processing and compute-heavy workloads. Built on the KVM hypervisor, the server utilizes the x86_64 architecture and provides 56 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring consistent CPU performance without resource sharing. The processor configuration is paired with 224 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined 32 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration is supported by 944 GB of local SSD storage, which provides fast data access for localized datasets. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of legacy NVIDIA P100 GPUs offers a resource-dense option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand the latest generation of tensor cores. This makes the instance suitable for legacy deep learning models, scientific simulations, and parallel database queries where dedicated physical cores and local SSD storage are critical.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 instance features 56 dedicated physical cores with no hyperthreading, paired with 224 GB of system memory. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are delivered by two NVIDIA P100 GPUs, providing a total of 32 GB of VRAM. For storage and connectivity, the instance includes 944 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Lacking modern CPU instruction extensions like AVX-512 or AMX, this server is best suited for legacy GPU-accelerated tasks, deep learning inference, and scientific simulations that benefit from dedicated physical cores and local SSD storage.
